name: features-stock-daily
notes: NEUTRAL TEMPLATE (workflow step `daily`): the volume/liquidity and market-relative feature table of a stock universe, one row per (entity, date), from the daily bars alone. Every project value is a ${name.path} placeholder filled from the step's `in` map: T the entity list, B the bar source (store reference, per-entity relpath, `columns` file column -> output field, `fields` the roles naming those outputs), M the benchmark (one entity's close series, same shape plus `symbol`), Q the key field names (entity, date), F the feature declarations handed unchanged to the DailyBarFeatures node (windows, output names), W the work dir, L the output locations, stream the table's name. Same-day by design: the row at date t uses t's own bar, so the consumer attaches it with a same-day (strict_prior false) keyed table, valid because the entry decision is taken at the close that defines t's bar. The benchmark must cover every bar date it should be relative to: a date with no benchmark close gives null features, never a fill. The output is the keyed table a families.keyed source reads: key fields Q.entity and Q.date, one column per declared feature, null where undefined (window not yet full, zero volume). LEVELS ACROSS SPLITS: volumes and closes are split-adjusted at the data's end, so vl_log_volume (a level) is shifted by ln(ratio) for rows before a later split (hindsight adjustment); the ratio, return, beta and correlation features are unaffected, and vl_log_dollar_volume is invariant, so prefer it where a level is needed across splits.

params.provenance_waiver: each row carries its own entity field; the key check proves no entity appears twice

bars.notes: All entities' bars in one stream, entity order = the foreach order.

benchmark_rows.notes: The benchmark's daily closes through the store (manifest sha256 checked), keyed by its own symbol.

features.notes: Trailing windows count each entity's own consecutive bars; log returns; benchmark aligned by date. Windows and output names are F's, never typed here.

params.source: Daily-bar volume/liquidity and market-relative features per (entity, date), same-day; read as a keyed table (families.keyed)

table.notes: The hand-off file. The writer refuses to overwrite and the parent directory must exist, so a repeat run moves the work dir aside first.

foreach.notes: One read per entity; the entity is the only per-entity setting and arrives as the foreach key.

prices.notes: This entity's bar file through the store; B.columns maps file columns to the fields the feature node reads.

tagged.notes: Adds the entity field from the foreach key (the file carries none under a project-neutral name). The single empty-when case is the declared catch-all.
